title: Matt's Modular Armory
description: Mod that aims to add modular tools, weapons and armor with custom upgrades
body:
Matt's Modular Armory introduces 4 new tool, weapon and armor tiers, that use a customizable augment system, that allows for their modification, players are able to add and remove augments at will.

The mod is in its early stages, content is subject to change (especially the textures)

Available tiers:
- Modular Clay (comparable to stone)
- Advanced Modular Clay (comparable to iron) (recomended to augment it with the diamond sharpened augment)
- Adaptive Flesh (comparable to diamond)
- Biorite (comparable to netherite)

All tiers allow for different amount of inserted augments

Avilable functional blocks:
- Modular Assembler - used for the crafting of modular items, functions similary to the stone cutter
- Augment Table - used to insert the augments into the modular items
- Repair Table - used to repair the modular items using their plates
- Block Exposer - used to transform or create items depending on the blocks that surround it (with JEI integration)

Plans for the future:
- add more augment
- add more tools and weapons
